jobs.title: Director, Finance Capital & Procurement
jobs.description:
Summary

Director, Finance Capital & Procurement is a highly skilled and strategic leader who will lead and manage the accounting, risks, controls and processes and provide support around the company’s spend relating to capital and procurement both direct and indirect. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Fixed Asset and Capital

- Direct the accounting and management of the company’s fixed assets, including asset capitalization, depreciation, and impairment

- Establish and enforce policies and procedures for the accurate tracking, recording, and reporting of fixed assets.

- Provide direction & guidance on large capital projects

- Support the preparation and development of project master budgets for large projects

- Design and manage financial models to support the management of project spend and project status.  Ensure data integrity of data being used in reports and ad hoc requests

- Facilitates regular status meeting with essential parties to ensure transparency of project status and expectations

- Develop and communicate standard operating procedures to ensure that there is an effective and efficient system of internal controls

- Monthly, quarterly and annual reconciliation and reporting

- Ensure proper Delegation of Spending Authority adherence prior to capital execution

- Leads, manages, and supports the production of central reporting, analysis and insight related to our commodity costs.

- Oversee financial support for material spend across key processes, including forecasting, budgeting, cash management, strategic planning. Partner Procurement category teams in key deliverables for these areas.

- Drive global standardization and implement best practices globally for Procurement Finance activities, including forecasting, cash management, budgeting, strategic planning and reporting.

- Drives Productivity Programs for Procurement.

- Leads initiatives to identify inefficiencies and in current processes and procedures related to Procurement Finance. Oversee and drives projects to implement changes to streamline workflows, increase efficiency, harmonize and standardize process and ways of working for Procurement Finance

- Recommend process improvement and action plans

- Investigate opportunities to reduce Company risk and streamline processes

- Perform ad hoc financial analysis as required

- Perform other duties and participate in special projects as assigned

Requirements

- B.S. in Accounting or Finance.  CPA and/or MBA a plus

- 10 + years of relevant general accounting or finance experience

- 2-3 years fixed asset experience

- Strong analytical and problem solving, systems and communications skills

- Strong knowledge of US GAAP and financial reporting.  Ability to develop high levels of credibility and forge solid and positive professional relationships with subordinates, peers, and upper management

- Proficient in Microsoft products, database software and other applicable accounting and financial software and systems

- Proficient in ERP fixed asset modules.  Implementation a plus

- Ability to work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment

- Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and switch between tasks quickly

- Strong Leadership experience (leading leaders)

About Us

Chobani is a food maker with a mission of making high-quality and nutritious food accessible to more people, while elevating our communities and making the world a healthier place. In short: making good food for all. In support of this mission, Chobani is a purpose-driven, people-first, food-and-wellness-focused company, and has been since its founding in 2005 by Hamdi Ulukaya, an immigrant to the U.S. The Company manufactures yogurt, oat milk, and creamers – Chobani yogurt is America's No.1 yogurt brand, made with natural ingredients without artificial preservatives. Following the 2023 acquisition of La Colombe, a leading coffee roaster with a shared commitment to quality, craftmanship and impact, the Company began selling cold-pressed espresso and lattes on tap at cafés nationwide, as well as Ready to Drink (RTD) coffee beverages at retail. In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, a modern brand offering consumers nutritious, delicious and convenient ready-to-make meals.

Chobani uses food as a force for good in the world – putting humanity first in everything it does. The company's philanthropic efforts prioritize giving back to its communities and beyond. Chobani manufactures its products in New York, Idaho, Michigan and Australia, and its products are available throughout North America and distributed in Australia and other select markets.

For more information, please visit   www.chobani.com or follow us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Chobani is an equal opportunity employer. Chobani will not discriminate against any applicant for employment on any basis including, but not limited to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, military and/or veteran status, marital status, predisposing genetic characteristics and genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws.

The salary range for this full-time position is $140,000.00 - $200,000, + bonus + equity + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

Chobani provides a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, disability insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, and tuition reimbursement. To help save for the future, all employees are eligible for a 401k match of 100% on up to 5% of eligible pay. To support growing families, we provide fertility and childcare assistance, and 12 weeks of parental leave at full pay after six months of continuous employment. In addition, we provide wellness resources which include an employee assistance program, fitness discounts, a wellness reimbursement, on-site gym access (certain locations) and a monthly wellness newsletter to connect you with resources and timely information. We offer various types of paid time of including: 120 hours of paid time off, 11 holidays, and paid volunteer time off.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Content Manager
jobs.description:
Summary

Daily Harvest is looking for an Associate Brand Manager to be the boots-on-the-ground driver of our brand's most visible, culturally relevant work. This role sits at the intersection of social media, influencer marketing, and brand activations, and is central to bringing Daily Harvest to life for our customers every day.

We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-obsessed, and genuinely excited by culture, community, and the marketing that connects brands to people. You'll be responsible for keeping the wheels turning across social content, creator relationships, and live brand moments, ensuring everything goes out on time, on brand, and with purpose.

Reporting to the Brand Director, this person will collaborate closely with our creative team, agency partners, and influencer community to make sure Daily Harvest shows up consistently and compellingly across every consumer-facing touchpoint.

Responsibilities

Social Media
You'll be the day-to-day owner of Daily Harvest's social presence, keeping our channels fresh, on-brand, and strategically aligned.
●    Own the social content calendar, planning content across channels in alignment with brand priorities, evergreen content needs, and campaign moments
●    Brief the creative team on asset needs for social, writing clear, detailed briefs that reflect platform context, campaign goals, and brand voice
●    Brief and coordinate with content creators to produce platform-native content that resonates with our audience
●    Utilize tools like Nectar to monitor content performance, community engagement, and brand opportunities through social listening and AI

●    Manage relationships with influencers and creator partners on an ongoing basis, serving as their primary point of contact at Daily Harvest
●    Brief influencers on campaigns and partnership deliverables, ensuring they have everything they need to create great content
●    Oversee contracting and payment processes in partnership with legal and finance teams
●    Track deliverables, usage rights, and posting schedules to ensure all commitments are fulfilled
●    Help identify new creator partners that align with Daily Harvest's brand values and target audience
●    Maintain an organized system for tracking influencer performance and partnership history

●    Support the planning and execution of brand activations and experiential moments (frequency will be selective but high-impact)
●    Serve as an on-site point of contact to ensure events are executed flawlessly and reflect the brand
●    Recap activations with learnings and recommendations to inform future programming

●    Daily Harvest's social channels are well-organized, consistently updated, and performing against goals

●    Demonstrated experience managing social content calendars and briefing creative assets for social channels
●    Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, including briefing, relationship management, contracting, and tracking deliverables
●    Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented. A strong written communicator who can write clear, concise briefs and professional, partner-facing communications
●    Excited by cultural trends and genuinely interested in the creators, trends, and platforms shaping the consumer landscape

jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain Value Creation
jobs.description:
Summary

The Director, Supply Chain Value Creation will lead strategic initiatives focused on creating value, strengthening resilience, and advancing strategic priorities across Chobani’s upstream supply chain.
A central, multi-year priority for this role will be developing and advancing Chobani’s long-term upstream fruit sourcing strategy. This includes defining future sourcing models, evaluating grower, processor, and supplier networks, improving traceability, advancing domestic sourcing, and building the cross-functional roadmap required to support implementation over multiple years.
This role will operate at the intersection of Procurement, R&D, Product Development, Supplier Quality, Operations, Planning, and Finance to identify and advance opportunities across direct materials, supplier networks, sourcing models, and innovation processes.
The Director will lead complex initiatives that require cross-functional investigation, supplier collaboration, financial analysis, and clear recommendations. This includes advancing productivity opportunities, improving supply continuity and traceability, evaluating new supplier and material capabilities, and building processes to support innovation and growth.
This is not a traditional category management role. The position requires someone who can operate effectively in ambiguity, bring structure to complex and evolving business questions, evaluate options, build the business case, and guide cross-functional teams toward a practical path forward.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities
•    Develop and manage a multi-year upstream value creation roadmap across key direct materials, supplier networks, and strategic supply chain priorities.
•    Develop and lead Chobani’s multi-year upstream fruit sourcing strategy, including future sourcing models, grower, processor, and supplier networks, domestic sourcing, traceability, resilience, and implementation priorities.
•    Lead the cross-functional scoping and advancement of complex upstream fruit sourcing initiatives, including feasibility, business requirements, financial implications, governance, ownership, risks, and implementation planning.
•    Define the roadmap required to strengthen Chobani’s visibility and influence across the fruit supply chain, from grower and processor networks through fruit preparation and finished product use.
•    Evaluate opportunities to improve fruit sourcing through supplier partnerships, direct sourcing models, strategic agreements, network changes, new capabilities, and other long-term supply approaches.
•    Identify, evaluate, and advance productivity opportunities in partnership with Procurement, suppliers, R&D, Operations, and Finance.
•    Lead strategic investigations related to sourcing models, supplier capabilities, geographic diversification, domestic sourcing, traceability, supply continuity, and upstream risk.
•    Translate broad business needs into clear workplans, decision points, owners, timelines, and recommendations.
•    Evaluate alternative upstream supplier, material, processing, and supply chain models that improve cost, resilience, quality, flexibility, or competitive advantage.
•    Partner with Direct Procurement and suppliers to identify value creation opportunities beyond traditional negotiations, including specification optimization, supplier collaboration, network changes, process improvements, and strategic partnerships.
•    Lead cross-functional initiatives from initial investigation through recommendation, approval, transition planning, and implementation support.
•    Assess upstream supplier networks and identify gaps or opportunities related to capacity, capability, quality, continuity, traceability, and future business needs.
•    Partner with Product Development, R&D, Procurement, Supplier Quality, Operations, Planning, and Supply Chain Finance to improve how new materials, suppliers, trials, and product changes are evaluated and introduced.
•    Develop repeatable processes, tools, and governance for upstream value creation, supplier investigations, feasibility assessments, and trial execution.
•    Clarify cross-functional roles, required inputs, decision rights, and escalation paths for complex upstream and innovation-related initiatives.
•    Monitor relevant commodity, agricultural, supplier, and external market developments to identify emerging risks and opportunities.
•    Communicate recommendations, business cases, risks, and progress clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
•    Build strong relationships with internal teams, suppliers, processors, growers, industry partners, and external experts.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, Engineering, Agriculture, Food Science, Finance, or a related field. An MBA or advanced degree is a plus.

- Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Operations, Value Creation, or a related field.

- Experience leading complex, cross-functional supply chain initiatives from initial investigation through recommendation and implementation.

- Strong understanding of direct materials, supplier networks, sourcing strategies, and the factors that influence cost, quality, service, and supply continuity.

- Demonstrated ability to identify and deliver productivity or value creation opportunities across suppliers, materials, specifications, processes, or supply chain networks.

- Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience developing business cases, evaluating alternatives, quantifying risk, and measuring results.

- Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, bring structure to complex business questions, and develop practical, fact-based recommendations.

- Experience designing or improving cross-functional processes, governance, and ways of working.

- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead work across Procurement, R&D, Product Development, Supplier Quality, Operations, Planning, and Finance.

- Strong supplier relationship and collaboration skills, with the ability to work beyond traditional transactional or commercial discussions.

- Experience in the consumer packaged goods industry is required, preferably within food or beverage.

- Experience with fruit, agricultural ingredients, commodities, dairy, or other complex upstream food supply chains is strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with grower, processor, aggregator, and ingredient supplier networks, including traceability, domestic sourcing, agricultural risk, and multi-tier supply chains, is strongly preferred.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex information clearly to senior leadership.

- Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives while maintaining clear priorities, ownership, and follow-through.

- Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong commitment to innovation and continuous improvement.

- Proven leadership skills, including the ability to lead through influence and mobilize high-performing cross-functional teams.

- Obsession and passion for excellence!

jobs.title: Director of Finance - Plant
jobs.description:
Summary

The Director of Finance will lead Chobani's manufacturing and operations financial activities while working towards performance targets including cost, productivity, waste, and efficiency metrics. In addition, this role will be responsible for the development, analysis, review, and control of Chobani’s Supply Chain CAPEX program and working capital (i.e., Inventory). Through analysis, modeling, and recommendations, this role is key to driving and improving performance, implementing standard processes, and strengthening financial reporting and internal controls. Finally, this role will play a critical component in helping to refine the current process for analyzing platforms margins and looking for opportunities to improve.

This role is based on site in Twin Falls, Idaho.

Responsibilities

- Compile and analyze financial closing process, summarizing financial results with insights for business units and leadership.

- Prepare financial rolling forecast for COGS, calling out any risks and opportunities vs. plan.

- Manage monthly inventory reserve, reconciliation, and reporting process.

- Prepare month-end entries encompassing labor/overhead variances, inventory adjustments, manufacturing/PO variances, and machine-related entries.

- Collaborate with supply chain teams to implement cost-saving initiatives, drive accountability, and track progress against goals.

- Provide visibility to manufacturing, procurement, and logistics, focusing on continuous improvement and business performance/KPIs of operational drivers.

- Play a key role in supply planning as part of the monthly integrated business planning process and COGS financials.

- Partner with procurement to implement material price tracking and forecasting process.

- Support new product innovation initiatives, and margin analysis, and collaborate with data teams.

- Own COGS Annual Operating Plan and monthly Forecasting process, including modeling for raw materials, WIP and Finished Goods working with the supply chain on BOM inputs.

- Develop and perform and critique economic evaluation justifications for supply chain and plant capital expenditures.

- Own and revamp the overall obsolescence program focusing on analytics and reducing waste.

- Partner with operations to layout inventory KPIs and develop and track reduction initiatives.

- Revamp and propose enhancements to the current margin tracking process.

- Deliver critical cash flow guidance for executive leadership, enabling rebalancing of scarce, critical resources.

- Evaluate returns on investment for operations capital investments, optimizing cash company wide.

- Manage all aspects of budgeting, tracking, forecasting, and financial reporting of supply chain capital spending.

- Supervise, coach, develop and prioritize the workflow for Senior Financial Analyst.

- Compare financial results to planned or forecasted results and recommend future actions.

- Analyze the ongoing profitability of all new businesses and/or programs.

- Partner with Operations and demand management to forecast inventory positions.

- Provide Senior leadership with changes in working capital and CAPEX spend

- Enhance and lead control environment relating to SOX compliance in capital space while partnering with general accounting.

- Lead and provide insight into development of capital routing process.

- Prepare insights for monthly leadership reporting.

- Drive global process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Excellent analytic and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

- Experience managing CAPEX projects including Capital allocation and target setting

- Previous cross-functional leadership experience

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

jobs.title: Procurement Manager- Responsible Sourcing
jobs.description:
Summary

Chobani is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented, and proactive Procurement Manager to support and expand our Responsible Sourcing initiatives across the enterprise. The Procurement Manager is responsible for both executing the day-to-day responsibilities of our responsible sourcing strategy (i.e. supplier compliance, due diligence, and audit oversight) and contributing to the strategic development of the program as it matures. This role partners closely with Procurement, Sustainability, Supply Chain, Legal, Regulatory, Quality, and business stakeholders to ensure suppliers meet the organization's ethical, social, and environmental requirements. Beyond compliance, the Manager will play an active role in advancing our responsible sourcing ambitions: evaluating ingredient and supply chain risks, researching mitigation approaches, and developing recommendations that help Chobani source more responsibly over time.
The Manager will lead supplier due diligence activities, risk assessments, supplier engagement programs, audit remediation efforts, ESG monitoring, and compliance initiatives. The position plays a critical role in identifying and mitigating supply chain risks while supporting the organization's commitments to sustainability, human rights, supplier impact, and responsible business practices.
This position requires strong data management and analytical capabilities, including advanced proficiency in spreadsheets and database tools, to support reporting, compliance tracking, and continuous process improvement.  The ideal candidate is highly organized, intellectually curious, and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and accountability. This role supports Responsible Sourcing initiatives across all One Chobani brands, contributing directly to innovation, supply assurance, and responsible business practices.

Responsibilities

- Supplier Onboarding & Compliance
•    Partner closely with Sourcing teams to understand requirements and ensure sourcing activities align with quality, compliance, and ethical standards.
•    Onboard new suppliers and ingredients against Chobani’s Regulatory, Supplier Quality, and Responsible Sourcing requirements, ensuring adherence to all applicable policies including the Do Not Use List, Supplier Quality Manual, Economic Sanctions, and Sedex requirements; manage new supplier set-up in SAP.
•    Partner with Sourcing teams to align procurement activities with quality, compliance, sustainability and ethical standards.
•    Track and manage supplier compliance with Chobani’s Responsible Sourcing Program, including SRM Scorecard reporting and escalation of compliance issues.
Responsible Sourcing Program Management
•    Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Responsible Sourcing Program, including maintaining procedures, executing strategic initiatives, and identifying opportunities to advance program maturity.
•    Monitor emerging regulations, industry standards, and stakeholder expectations to inform program direction and keep Chobani ahead of evolving requirements, developing documentation, metrics, dashboards, and reporting as needed.
Supplier Risk & Due Diligence
•    Lead supplier risk assessments and due diligence reviews for new and existing suppliers, managing screening via Sedex and EcoVadis platforms.
•    Partner with category managers and sourcing teams to prioritize and develop mitigation plans for identified risks, including research and recommendations on solutions for key ingredient and supply chain risks.
•    Maintain risk monitoring tools, supplier risk profiles, and performance tracking against ESG and responsible sourcing objectives.
Data Analytics & Reporting
•    Develop and maintain supplier risk, compliance, and program dashboards; analyze data to surface trends, emerging risks, and opportunities
•    Support annual ESG, sustainability, regulatory, and compliance reporting requirements.
Supplier Engagement & Training
•    Conduct supplier outreach and engagement to strengthen responsible sourcing performance.
•    Support training for procurement teams and suppliers on responsible sourcing expectations and requirements.
•    Participate in industry forums, benchmarking initiatives, and external partnerships

Requirements

- Education & Experience
•    Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Risk Management, or related field.
•    Master's degree preferred.
•    5+ years of experience in Procurement, Supply Chain, Supplier Risk Management, Sustainability, ESG, Compliance, or Responsible Sourcing.
•    Experience conducting supplier due diligence and risk assessments.
•    Experience working with third-party risk monitoring platforms and supplier management systems.
•    Experience supporting audit, compliance, or sustainability initiatives preferred.
•    Experience with e sourcing tools, ERP systems (e.g., SAP), or procurement platforms preferred
Skills & Competencies
•    Strong understanding of responsible sourcing principles and supply chain due diligence practices.
•    Knowledge of:
•    Human rights due diligence frameworks
•    Modern Slavery regulations
•    Forced Labor Prevention requirements
•    ESG and sustainability standards
•    Supplier risk management methodologies
•    Anti-bribery and anti-corruption principles
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
•    Excellent project management and organizational capabilities.
•    Ability to influence stakeholders and drive cross-functional collaboration.
•    Strong Microsoft Excel & Power BI.
•    Ability to develop persuasive presentations to convey complex strategies.
•    Proficiency with data tracking, reporting tools, and process documentation.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
•    Strong relationship building skills, both internally and externally.
•    Ability to communicate complex information effectively amongst different groups of stakeholders.

jobs.description:
Summary

Director, Finance Capital & Procurement is a highly skilled and strategic leader who will lead and manage the accounting, risks, controls and processes and provide support around the company’s spend relating to capital and procurement both direct and indirect. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

Fixed Asset and Capital

- Direct the accounting and management of the company’s fixed assets, including asset capitalization, depreciation, and impairment

- Establish and enforce policies and procedures for the accurate tracking, recording, and reporting of fixed assets.

- Provide direction & guidance on large capital projects

- Support the preparation and development of project master budgets for large projects

- Design and manage financial models to support the management of project spend and project status.  Ensure data integrity of data being used in reports and ad hoc requests

- Facilitates regular status meeting with essential parties to ensure transparency of project status and expectations

- Develop and communicate standard operating procedures to ensure that there is an effective and efficient system of internal controls

- Monthly, quarterly and annual reconciliation and reporting

- Ensure proper Delegation of Spending Authority adherence prior to capital execution

- Leads, manages, and supports the production of central reporting, analysis and insight related to our commodity costs.

- Oversee financial support for material spend across key processes, including forecasting, budgeting, cash management, strategic planning. Partner Procurement category teams in key deliverables for these areas.

- Drive global standardization and implement best practices globally for Procurement Finance activities, including forecasting, cash management, budgeting, strategic planning and reporting.

- Drives Productivity Programs for Procurement.

- Leads initiatives to identify inefficiencies and in current processes and procedures related to Procurement Finance. Oversee and drives projects to implement changes to streamline workflows, increase efficiency, harmonize and standardize process and ways of working for Procurement Finance

- Recommend process improvement and action plans

- Investigate opportunities to reduce Company risk and streamline processes

- Perform ad hoc financial analysis as required

- Perform other duties and participate in special projects as assigned

- B.S. in Accounting or Finance.  CPA and/or MBA a plus

- Strong analytical and problem solving, systems and communications skills

- Strong knowledge of US GAAP and financial reporting.  Ability to develop high levels of credibility and forge solid and positive professional relationships with subordinates, peers, and upper management

- Proficient in Microsoft products, database software and other applicable accounting and financial software and systems

jobs.title: Director Category Management
jobs.description:
Summary

Daily Harvest built one of the most loyal followings in food, a decade of frozen fruit and vegetable-forward innovation and millions of DTC customers who have trusted the brand in their freezer every week.  In 2025, Chobani acquired Daily Harvest, pairing that consumer love with real infrastructure: supply chain scale, innovation prowess, and capital.
We have an exciting, all-new innovation pipeline ready to fuel our growth and are building our Retail team to drive a major expansion.  This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that will drive how Daily Harvest shows up in Retail across products, categories and retailers.
The Director of Category Management and Commercialization will be a strategic, analytically driven contributor who owns category management and commercialization support across our retail business.  This role is the connective force between data and decision-making, translating market insights, pricing dynamics, and shopper behavior into winning strategies that drive business growth.

Responsibilities

Category Management
Own the category management function for Daily Harvest, ensuring we make strategic decisions around our products and that we show up as a valued category partner to our retailers.
•    Build and maintain robust sales and category reporting and performance measurement materials and routines
•    Develop actionable insights from syndicated data and retailer-specific POS data to inform business and retailer strategy
•    Serve as the internal category expert, identifying white space, competitive pressures, and trend-driven opportunities
•    Leverage syndicated and retailer platforms to identify actionable insights around shopper demos and purchasing behavior
•    Partner with the cross-functional Daily Harvest team to identify and build the innovation story: how new products fit within the category context and drive incremental growth for the retailer
•    Partner with cross-functional team, data providers and insights platforms to drive custom research and insights studies

Sales Planning & Customer Presentations:

•    Be the analytical engine behind winning customer presentations, turning data into compelling selling stories
•    Build best-in-class retailer presentations, making the case for Daily Harvest with data and insights, and clear stewardship of Daily Harvest’s brand differentiators
•    Partner with the Sales team to understand each retailer's priorities and tailor materials to their specific KPIs and retailer priorities
•    Create repeatable sales planning tools and templates that improve the team's efficiency and consistency across customer touchpoints
Commercialization and GTM Support:
•    Own assortment strategy, recommending the right product mix by retailer and channel to maximize performance and minimize cannibalization
•    Pricing, trade & Promotion:
o    Conduct price and pack architecture analysis across channels and customers, identifying optimal pack sizes and price points
o    Analyze competitive pricing and shelf dynamics to inform positioning recommendations and flag risks to the business
o    Lead price elasticity analysis and drive pricing architecture frameworks and recommendations
o    Support the analysis of trade promotion effectiveness across accounts and programs, evaluating ROI, volume lift, and efficiency to inform future investment decisions
o    Support the development of promotional pricing strategy by customer and channel
•    Shopper Marketing:
o    Partner with Brand Director and lead shopper marketing program strategy and oversight, developing programs that convert shoppers into DH buyers
o    Complement the retail media team’s efforts with shopper marketing strategies that work across the full path to purchase (this role does not manage retail media directly)
